scan.description: v0.7+. Scan-time configuration (workspace detection + exclude globs).

workspaceDetection.description: v0.7+. Workspace-detection mode. auto = inspect package.json + nested package.json files. force-single = treat as single-workspace regardless of layout. force-monorepo = treat as monorepo even when only one package.json is found.

excludes.description: v0.7+. Glob patterns to exclude during scan (applied during file walk).

f13.description: v0.6+. F13 (Implicit output format) detection configuration.

outputFormatExceptions.description: Prompt IDs (from inventory.json) that intentionally request flexible output. F13 suppresses on these prompts.

f6.description: v0.7+. F6 (model registry / suspect-model) detection configuration.

modelIdExceptions.description: Model IDs to treat as known even when missing from the bundled known-models list. Suppresses F6-suspect-model on these.

autoHandoffVibeSec.description: v0.6+. When true AND F12 critical fires, :remediate invokes /vibe-sec:audit automatically. Opt-in only; default false preserves v0.5 banner-only behavior.

applyVoiceFrameFixes.description: v0.6+. When true, Category B voice-frame rewrites follow normal confidence routing (auto-write if confidence ≥0.90). When false (default), voice-frame rewrites always stage for user review regardless of confidence.

applyInlineToRegistry.description: v0.7+. When true, Category D-1 inline-to-registry diffs follow normal confidence routing (auto-write at >=0.90). When false (default), D-1 diffs always stage for user review.

applyTypedRenderer.description: v0.7+. When true, Category D-2 typed-renderer diffs follow normal confidence routing. When false (default), D-2 diffs always stage.

applyModelConsolidation.description: v0.7+. When true, Category D-3 model-consolidation diffs follow normal confidence routing. When false (default), D-3 diffs always stage.
